plan: Implement the first novel canvas panel: character relationships. Create CharacterCanvasPanel rendering StoryEntity (kind=character) nodes on InfiniteCanvas connected by EntityRelation edges, with CanvasNodeShell for node rendering, drag-to-connect relation creation, context menu, editor drawers, keyboard shortcuts, and CanvasLayout persistence (panelKey='character-canvas'). selfReflection: The character canvas panel is the first full integration of the canvas core with novel domain data. Key design decisions: (1) CharacterNodeContent is a separate pure presentational component — keeps CanvasNodeShell generic while allowing domain-specific node interiors. (2) useCanvasPanel hook handles all canvas state (viewport/nodes/edges/selection/history/persistence) so the panel component focuses on domain data loading and UI. (3) SVG edge layer uses pointer-events:none on container with pointer-events:stroke on individual paths — allows edge clicks without blocking node interactions. (4) Connection drag uses connectingRef to avoid stale closures. (5) Old RelationsView completely removed (architecture-phase rule: no backward compat). The circle layout strategy positions character nodes in a circle for relationship visualization. CreateRelationModal uses antd Modal+Form pattern. All 109 tests pass, tsc clean.

selfAssessment.reason: First panel integration validates the canvas core + persistence + useCanvasPanel hook architecture. The pattern (load domain data via useLiveQuery → convert to CanvasPanelItem[] → useCanvasPanel manages canvas state → render InfiniteCanvas+CanvasNodeShell+SVG edges) is reusable for the remaining 3 panels.
